statement: Anthropic has signed about $517 billion of compute capacity agreements in the past eleven months, far above the roughly $180 billion server-rental spend it previously guided investors toward through 2029.
why: Contracted compute commitments at a single frontier lab are the clearest forward read on how much accelerator and datacenter capacity must be built and bought.

impact.mechanism: Half a trillion dollars of signed compute leases obliges cloud and neocloud counterparties to procure accelerators, power and datacenter shells to serve them, converting lab commitments into merchant-GPU and infrastructure orders.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic has signed $517 billion in compute capacity leases in the past 11 months... signed these agreements since October last year.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet compiling another outlet's analysis; both the DCD article and the underlying report were blocked by paywall, so only search-surfaced excerpts were read and the figure is an analyst tally, not a company disclosure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 35.0 -> 517.0 (tol 1%); sources: 247wallst.com, datacenterdynamics.com
